extracted.stage: Ongoing financial remedy proceedings, hearing listed
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Okafor Law enquires about roughly £27,000 of funding for a client's representation in ongoing financial remedy proceedings where the matrimonial pot is around £515,000 and a hearing is listed for 18 October 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client regarding funding for her financial remedy proceedings. We have noted the indicative figures of approximately £27,000 sought against a matrimonial pot of around £515,000, and the hearing listed for 18 October. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court dealing with the matter, details of the assets in dispute and their liquidity, the stage and procedural history of the proceedings, a costs estimate through to settlement or trial, and your client's identification and contact details. Once we have that information a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
